text: Chapters 8 and 9 taught index maintenance, statistics maintenance, DBCC CHECKDB, and finding resource bottlenecks — things a DBA can run by hand once, but nobody wants to run every week across dozens of databases.

Almost nobody hand-writes their own maintenance scripts from zero. Ola Hallengren's Maintenance Solution is the real, widely-adopted, free community standard — smart rebuild-versus-reorganize decisions, statistics updates, and integrity checks, all pre-built.

Integrity check first — no point optimizing a corrupted database. Index maintenance second, which updates statistics as a side effect. Statistics maintenance third. Running these out of order wastes work.

Azure SQL Database has limited native Agent support and already automates much of this maintenance itself — a DBA's job there shifts toward verifying that automation is actually working, not scheduling it from scratch.
Automate what Chapters 8-9 taught you, in the right order, using tools the community already built. Next up: one real maintenance and monitoring strategy tying Chapters 7-10 together.
